title: LaunchTrailer, made by 10 year kids during Canadian Thanksgiving weekend - Shinobi Brawl. Feedback please.
author: ButterflyPlenty2

comments.author: ButterflyPlenty2
comments.body:
Here is the original drawings made by 3 kids, used Claude Code and my Laptop to build this for $0 cost, in 2 hours and then a couple hours of refinement and cleaning up. Overall, game launched and trailer made in a weekend, bringing kids imagination to a real life playable online game, so the kids can aura farm in school 😁😜
